name: Headlights
source:
Are you happy with your life? 

Are you content?

Don't ignore what's inside you.

You wake up after a nap... Your entire body hurts, but you know what you need to do.

[From [url=https://toroyachi.itch.io/headlights]Itch.io[/url]]
